profile.name: Fire
profile.gearTooltip:
Preset gear lists are intended as rough approximations of BIS, and will often not be the absolute highest-DPS setup for you. Your optimal gear setup will depend on many factors; that's why we have a sim!

Items may also be omitted from the presets if they are highly contested and clearly better utilized on other classes, to encourage equitable gearing for the raid as a whole.

mechanics.title: External support
mechanics.reason: The shared support package is an abstract experiment configuration. A legal raid roster supplying every buff has not been validated.

mechanics.title: Cooldown execution
mechanics.reason: The report records actual activation and uptime. Supplied timing is preserved and is not an optimized racial schedule or a measurement of player execution.
